Fixes whole-picture mirroring by keeping camera frames BGRA instead of silently falling back to NV12.
Retires the separate Producer Portrait Camera through macOS extension removal.
Keeps portrait set routing, saved mirror preference, and existing guest startup/recovery improvements.
Windows retains its native Live engine; Intel macOS and Linux retain their existing engine-less scope.
